title: Concept: OS command execution via system (perl) — review required
description: In perl, system executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (IPC::Run or list-form open) are perl-specific.
applicability: perl codebases that launch external processes through system; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
